notes: Official sales search explicitly says it does not include every historically released product. Completeness means coverage of retrieved official KT indexes, not an absolute claim over undocumented variants.
Sales names for three-digit models retain the official (F) notation; no inference about the exact F equipment meaning.
Suffix specification rows can have horsepower values inconsistent with the base row (KT24-FHN/FHT/HN/HT show 27 hp vs KT24 at 24 hp); do not copy those to basic-model cards.
Point sheets and maintenance sheets are additional documents for the same model, not additional machines.
Some PC entries occur twice in the sales-year index; exact row duplicates were not counted as additional models.
